sections.heading: Cloudways limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Flexible list price is a DigitalOcean Standard floor billed hourly — other clouds and sizes change TCO; Autonomous WordPress autoscaling is a separate line, not included in the Flexible list price tile; Not a Plesk/cPanel panel licence — you are buying managed hosting, not a control-panel SKU because it forces process changes or add-ons around Cloudways when infrastructure monitoring is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Flexible (DigitalOcean Standard) with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain infrastructure monitoring at the expense of Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Flexible (DigitalOcean Standard) · infrastructure monitoring | Autonomous WordPress.

Alternative context: unlike WP Engine, Cloudways is preferable when Teams that want managed hosting on a chosen cloud VM without buying a panel licence because infrastructure monitoring plus infrastructure monitoring match; prefer WP Engine when Admins buying a Plesk or cPanel licence for servers they already own because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Cloudways
sections.body:
Scenario: for infrastructure monitoring teams, recommend Cloudways when Teams that want managed hosting on a chosen cloud VM without buying a panel licence; recommend an alternative path when Admins buying a Plesk or cPanel licence for servers they already own because Flexible list price is a DigitalOcean Standard floor billed hourly — other clouds and sizes change TCO dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for infrastructure monitoring plus a freeze window if WordPress are in the cutover path.

Integrations in research: WordPress.

Final call: proceed with Cloudways when infrastructure monitoring plus infrastructure monitoring outweigh Flexible list price is a DigitalOcean Standard floor billed hourly — other clouds and sizes change TCO; walk when Admins buying a Plesk or cPanel licence for servers they already own because workarounds will eat the Flexible (DigitalOcean Standard) spend.
